label: Owner decision 2026-11-06: find a byte-stable Catechism witness
summary: Owner decision 2026-11-06: find a byte-stable Catechism witness. Tried: the Latin typical edition on vatican.va (archive/catechism_lt): several byte variants, CI fetched different bytes for every page (earlier PR #1101); Wayback: unreachable from the pinning environment (CDX and capture requests time out); USCCB flipbook: behind a bot-challenge page; parish hosts (scborromeo.org, catholicculture.org): stable but not official. Pinned: the official English translation on vatican.va (archive/ENG0015 __PA, __PB, __P14, __P16) as raw page bytes, byte-stable over ten fetches with the source-evidence User-Agent; claims carry basis translation. The ordinary-use knowability premise moves from bare to supported; the confession premise gains Catechism support beside the creed.
blocker: CI stability of the English pages is checked only by this PR's runs. If a later verification reports byte drift, the witness check fails and must be repaired (re-pin after a fidelity re-read) or the affected claims and supports withdrawn; the frontier does not downgrade the premise by itself. A Latin witness remains the upgrade.
